title.zh: 同叫Barrier，拦的不是同一种风险
title.en: Both are called barriers, but they block different risks

subtitle.zh: W偏向化学与成核界面；Cu偏向扩散与连续导电
subtitle.en: W emphasizes chemistry and nucleation interfaces; Cu emphasizes diffusion and continuous conduction

body.zh: W Plug / Contact；Si；Ti： 附着 / 吸杂 / 接触控制；TiN：抑制反应 / 成核界面；W：主体填充
body.en: W plug / contact Si Ti: adhesion / gettering / contact control TiN: reaction suppression / nucleation interface W: bulk fill

body.zh: 主要威胁；WF₆相关反应；成核与覆盖；接触电阻
body.en: Main threats WF₆-related reactions Nucleation and coverage Contact resistance

body.zh: Cu Dual Damascene；Low-k；TaN:Cu扩散阻挡；Ta：界面衔接；Cu Seed： 连续导电路径
body.en: Cu dual damascene Low-k TaN: Cu diffusion barrier Ta: interface transition Cu seed: a continuous conductive path

body.zh: 主要威胁；Cu向介质扩散；Seed断裂；界面可靠性
body.en: Main threats Cu diffusion into the dielectric Seed discontinuity Interface reliability

body.zh: W要填得进去且界面稳；Cu要铜不跑出去且导电不中断
body.en: W must fill the opening with a stable interface; Cu must stay confined with uninterrupted conduction

body.zh: W；向内成核；与覆盖；稳住界面
body.en: W Inward nucleation and coverage Stabilize the interface

body.zh: Cu；阻止向外扩散；保持连续导电；稳住电流路径
body.en: Cu Prevent outward diffusion Maintain continuous conduction Stabilize the current path
